name: Compounding Crush
description: Press down with a force that doubles on itself each breath until the target is pinned to the ground.

name: Boundless Surge
description: Surge forward with a force that has no top to it and let it rise as the blow lands.

name: Relentless Hold
description: Hold the target in a grip that tightens by a little with every second it is kept.

name: Endless Refrain
description: Sing a refrain of power into an ally that adds its strength to itself with each repeat.

name: Cascading Ruination
description: Start a collapse of force that cascades outward and takes more with each wave it sends.

name: Limitless Pierce
description: Pierce with a point that keeps lengthening until it finds the far side of the guard.

name: Infinite Ward
description: Hold a ward that grows to match any assault laid upon it and never thins.

name: Unceasing Mend
description: Pour a mend that does not cease while the user stands and that grows stronger with the length of the wound.

name: Runaway Cascade
description: Loose a cascade whose force runs away from the user and wounds all it crosses beyond recall.

name: Infinite Recoil
description: Catch a strike and return it with the force of every strike that came before it.

name: Inexhaustible Core
description: Draw blows into the Core as fuel and lift the strength of the user and near allies with it.

name: Infinite Ascent
description: The school's ascent in which every effort lifts the next and the whole climb breaks on the target at once.

name: Unbounded Collapse
description: Start a collapse that feeds on its own force and grows to the destructive ceiling of its tier before it ends.

name: Perpetual Press
description: Press on the target with a weight that never lessens however long the press is held.

name: Ceaseless Wave
description: Send wave after wave of qi from the palms that keeps coming as long as the stance holds.

name: Everrenew Ward
description: Renew a ward at the instant it fails so that there is never a gap in it.

name: Undying Reserve
description: Open a reserve that does not run dry and share its draught with a weary ally.

name: Tireless Onslaught
description: Attack without rest in a flurry whose power grows each round and never slackens.

name: Eternal Reflux
description: Turn a blow back so it returns again from the striker and again after that.

name: Infinite Bind
description: Cast a binding that lengthens and multiplies with each pull until there is nothing the target can reach.

name: Perpetual Revival
description: Restart a heart stopped only moments ago and keep it beating with a stream that does not fail.

name: Endless Annihilation
description: Cast a ruin that does not stop spreading and whose wounds persist wherever it has touched.

name: Mirrorfall
description: Drop a fall of mirrored wards that bounce each blow among themselves without end.

name: Immeasurable Torrent
description: Pour an immeasurable torrent of restoring qi over the wounded that does not run out until all are mended.

name: Infinite Recursion
description: The school's recursion in which a blow contains a smaller blow of itself and that another without end.

name: Aeon Unfolding
description: The school's unfolding in which ages of effort are spread across a single step and a single guard.

name: Endless Ruin
description: Set a ruin in motion that spreads and feeds without limit until it reaches the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Infinity Unbound
description: Cut every bound on a surge of force and let it grow without a stop up to the ceiling of the tier's destruction.
